assessment.report:
# Tiered test execution start assessment

The Lead reviewed the user's approved scoped-test design and added explicit Explorer lookup after target behaviors/modules are known. Complete case coverage and manual/E2E mappings remain distinct from per-iteration execution. Tester judges sufficiency, selection and actual results; Lead owns scope/cost authority. Explorer returns exact evidence and uncertainty without certifying pass or authorizing skipped coverage. Directed discovery is complete and the Tester packet is ready before writer GO.

The existing architecture remains adequate. Extend the efficient-test-execution section as sole policy; keep role/Skill routes concise and record minimal selection, input-sensitive reuse, remaining full-gate checks and cost/checkpoint decisions in existing templates. Iteration checks grow to affected modules/dependents, stage core smoke and delivery full fallback; uncertain or cross-cutting impacts expand rather than guess. Same-input reuse requires trusted reachable evidence and includes dirty working code/tests/dependencies/configuration/fixtures/environment/external state. Expensive batches have task-specific forecasts/resources and safe budget checkpoints, not universal time cutoffs. No new selector/cache engine, test framework, production seam, schema, model setting or structural refactor is warranted.

Both complete README/changelog pairs and release policy were read. Source 0.9.5 is a focused patch extension, not an installed update or stable release. Prior dirty 0.9.4 repair-guard changes are captured as the baseline and preserved. New task results belong in the active packet, not README. No active PRD or OpenSpec opt-in authority exists for this bounded task. Other inventoried docs and historical results are preserved, not re-certified. Planned native/public-doc and relevant isolated package, fake-home, documentation and stage checks will run only after coherent source; real Agent adherence remains pending. Existing PyYAML quick-validator limitation must not be called a pass or trigger package installation.

Needed named roles are present in active tool catalog. Actual fresh Explorer selector team-explorer returned /root/test_scope_explorer; original named Tester /root/concurrency_tester and Docs Maintainer /root/repair_guard_writer_v2 are reused with their original selections. Loaded role/model metadata are unknown. Reviewer assignment waits for the coherent writer pass and confirmed capacity. Lead retains readiness/administrative version provenance only; writers have nonoverlapping boundaries and do not recursively delegate. This review covers this task alone; subsequent material source/packet changes require a fresh close assessment.
